description: This source file implements classes and functions related to application state change notifications within a process container environment, specifically the AWC (Application Widget Controller) implementation. It defines notifier and listener classes for managing and dispatching state change events.

classes.name: AWCStateChangeNotifier
classes.description: Manages a list of listeners interested in application state changes, allowing adding, removing, and notifying listeners.

classes.name: AWCListener
classes.description: A listener class that reacts to window change and state change events, forwarding state change notifications to the assigned notifier.

methods.name: AWCStateChangeNotifier::addListener
methods.description: Registers a new listener if it is not already registered.

methods.name: AWCStateChangeNotifier::removeListener
methods.description: Removes an existing listener from the notification list.

methods.name: AWCStateChangeNotifier::notify
methods.description: Notifies all registered listeners about a state change event.

methods.name: AWCListener::notifyWindowChange
methods.description: Placeholder for handling window change events; currently does nothing.

methods.name: AWCListener::notifyStateChange
methods.description: Handles notification of a state change, logging the event and forwarding it to the notifier.

methods.name: AWCListener::notifyServiceReady
methods.description: Placeholder for handling service readiness; currently does nothing.
